title: Middle Full Stack Engineer
description:
Middle Full Stack Engineer

 

We’re building the Production ready system from the PoC and looking for a Middle Full Stack Engineer who enjoys creating scalable products and taking ownership of real technical decisions. You’ll work closely with product and design teams, shape parts of the architecture, and help turn ideas into a production-ready platform.

 

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of software development experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern ES6+
  • Good experience with React and Next.js
  • Good experience with backend development using Node.js / NestJS
  • Hands-on experience with MongoDB and PostgreSQL
  • Experience building scalable applications and contributing to system architecture
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, product-driven environments
  • Good communication skills and ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Upper-Intermediate English (B2+)

 

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with MQTT
  • Experience with React Native or WebSockets
  • Experience working in startup or early-stage environments
  • Experience building applications that can be deployed on both OnPrem and Cloud platforms
  • Experience with Azure, IoT Hub, Microsoft Entra ID

 

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and deliver key features of a new product from concept to launch
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of scalable frontend and backend architecture
  • Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering teams
  • Continuously improve performance, reliability, and scalability of the platform.
